# Firas Ridene

> Firas Ridene: AI Engineer based in Tunis, Tunisia, specialized in Generative AI & Multi-Agent Systems. Builds multi-agent systems, real-time voice agents, and AI automation pipelines that ship to production.

I'm an AI engineer and computer science engineering student at Esprit in Tunis, specialized in generative AI and multi-agent systems. I design intelligent assistants and automation systems that reduce manual work and improve decision-making.

I continuously explore new tools and frameworks to build the right stack per use case, always prioritizing the most relevant solution over a familiar one.

I build agent systems that do real work. Voice agents that answer phones. An agent team that ships code. Pipelines that cut manual prospecting by 80%. I design multi-agent systems end-to-end and pick the stack per problem, not per habit.

### Churn Prediction & Billing Analysis, Telecom Subscriber Data

A predictive analytics project uncovering key churn drivers and revenue patterns across 20K telecom subscribers to power targeted retention strategies. (Data science)

- Analyzed 20k subscriber records to uncover churn drivers, retention dynamics, and revenue patterns.
- Built cohort and monthly churn analysis, identifying early-tenure churn segmented by technology and acquisition channel.
- Linked billing patterns to retention behavior and proposed a churn prediction framework to prioritize retention actions.
- Stack: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib
- Details: https://firasridene.tech/#churn-prediction-billing-analysis-telecom-subscriber-data

### Store Support Agent

AI customer support agent for e-commerce that checks real inventory before promising availability, and resists prompt-injection attempts to override its own rules. (AI Automation)

- Built a multi-agent support system where an orchestrator dispatches to RAG, inventory, and order-capture subagents, syncing live across Notion and Google Sheets.
- Handled the overselling edge case deterministically, refusing to confirm stock that's already pending on another order.
- Defended against prompt injection with no discount/price tools in the system, a pre-filter guard, and a structured-output schema as a final backstop, tested against a set of adversarial prompts.
- Stack: n8n, Notion, Google Sheets, Supabase, pgvector, Claude, Next.js, Vercel
- Details: https://firasridene.tech/#store-support-agent
- Source: https://github.com/RideneFiras/MultiAppHackathon
- Demo: https://youtu.be/t3_HilAUTEQ

### ChronoWorks

Unified platform for freelancers to manage clients, projects, time, tasks, leave, and invoices in one linked system. (SaaS · freelance ops)

- Designed a linked data model where logging time on a task feeds project status, leave-adjusted totals, and client invoices automatically.
- Built a locked invoicing system with gapless numbering and immutable issued invoices, enforced with Postgres triggers and row-level security.
- Implemented tax-profile logic for Tunisia and France, covering VAT, matricule fiscal, stamp duty, and reverse charge.
- Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, dnd-kit, Vercel
- Details: https://firasridene.tech/#chronoworks
- Source: https://github.com/RideneFiras/ChronoWorks
